name: velvetos-office-control-plane
title: Office Control Plane — unify existing sources of truth
rule: Unify and harden. Do not duplicate approval queue, calendar, media catalog, job ledger, print.done, office loop, or handoff concepts. If two files claim authority over the same domain, the sensor must fail.

dontBotherChristian.green: execute autonomously (classify, archive, draft internal, maintain handoff, routine quality fixes)
dontBotherChristian.yellow: execute + report in brief (prepare content, organize media, calendar plan, watchdog repairs)
dontBotherChristian.orange: prepare only, do not execute (new external message, unverified public claim, policy change, missing gate)
dontBotherChristian.red: Christian approval required (purchase, payment, price change, destructive action, owner-only publish, hard blocker, irreversible deletion, uncovered business commitment)

keep: optional Velvet Publish Watch / hard-blocker alert
chatgptTaskReduction.note: Do not delete existing ChatGPT tasks until the replacement path is proven.
